keys.name: Mirae Electrical Room
steps: Use the northwest hospital parking entrance; turn left and descend to the basement.
Unlock the single door beside the purple wall marked Danger.

keys.name: Counting Room Vault
steps: Enter the casino front entrance; take the right corridor.
Turn left, then unlock the door at the far end.

keys.name: Coin Mining Den
steps: Find the apartment north of The Grid, east of the western gas station.
Go to floor 3; use the right-hand door.

keys.name: Roze's Highrise Armory
steps: Use Netshin’s rear entrance, stairs and fire exit.
On floor 14, turn right to the OFFICE glass door.

keys.name: Gangbyeon Apartment B
keys.acquisition: Random spawn inside Gangbyeon Apartment A, Compound Echo.
steps: Search Apartment A, beside Apartment B, for a random desk or shelf key spawn.
Climb the exterior pipes into A’s window; if needed, use the LTV from B’s basement garage as a platform.
Use the key at Apartment B.

keys.name: Gun Store Weapons Locker
keys.acquisition: Explosives Equipment Kit at levels 16 and 19; Trap Equipment Kit at level 42.
steps: Unlock a weapons locker inside either listed gun store.

keys.name: Blackmarket Weapons Locker
keys.acquisition: Recon Equipment Kit at levels 19 and 46.
steps: Unlock a weapons locker inside either listed blackmarket.

keys.name: Vault Armory
keys.acquisition: Random loot; no guaranteed spawn reported.
steps: Take the casino rear entrance and right-hand double doors.
Cross to the emergency exit; descend to parking.
Continue through the blue-wall double doors to the armory.

keys.name: Field Depot
keys.acquisition: Random loot; no guaranteed spawn reported.
steps: Find the flag-marked supply warehouse northeast of the air-base clinic.
On floor 1, use the left door behind the Ammo Armor Cache to reach the maintenance room.

keys.name: Reactor 02 Control Room
keys.acquisition: Random loot; no guaranteed spawn reported.
steps: From the northeast checkpoint, climb pipes behind the substation.
Drop left and break the Reactor 02 skylight to enter.
Use the damaged crane to reach the left-hand control-room door.
requirements: Heavy guards and radiation; bring Radiation Blockers and a Gas Mask.

keys.name: Shop Records Room
keys.acquisition: Random loot; no guaranteed spawn reported.
steps: Find the Goh24 south of the stadium clinic.
The records room is upstairs.

keys.name: Old Barber Shop
keys.acquisition: Random loot; no guaranteed spawn reported.
steps: Look beside the crab shack on the wharf’s south side.

keys.name: Shopping DRC Locker
keys.acquisition: Random loot; no guaranteed spawn reported.
steps: Optional: Operation Shopping Hacks can help locate the DRC Labs; it is not listed as a key prerequisite.
Reach NuriGO’s secured lower parking area and DRC Labs terminal.
Spend 4 K9 Battery Cores to enter the labs.
At the far-right tent, spend 8 more cores; find the white locker in the upper-left area.
requirements: 12 K9 Battery Cores total; loot downed K9s before detonation.

keys.name: Imjin Mill Foreman's Office
keys.acquisition: Random loot; no guaranteed spawn reported.
steps: Find the rice mill’s central building.
On floor 1, unlock the brown OFFICE door.

keys.name: Executive Arms Auction
keys.acquisition: Random loot; no guaranteed spawn reported.
steps: Optional: Operation Grid Assault can start you in The Grid.
Enter DBN and find the northwest ground-floor fire exit.
Take the ascenders to floor 22, then the left door.
Unlock the left-hand Dining Room double doors.

keys.name: Re-Education Center Annex
keys.acquisition: Random loot; no guaranteed spawn reported.
steps: Enter the central propaganda-fronted building.
Turn right and unlock the west-wing brown door.

keys.name: Police Station Armory
keys.acquisition: Random loot; no guaranteed spawn reported.
steps: Unlock an armory at any of the four reported police stations.

keys.name: The Citadel Side Access
keys.acquisition: Random loot; no guaranteed spawn reported.
steps: Look for security-grille doors with Korean lettering.
The key works at side entrances and roof access doors.
